mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = #{value} LIMIT 1
SELECT group_code AS groupCode, group_nm AS groupName, COALESCE(group_dc, '') AS groupDesc FROM tb_common_code_group WHERE tenant_id = #{value} ORDER BY sort_order, group_code

SELECT g.group_code AS groupCode, i.item_code AS code, i.item_nm AS codeName, COALESCE(p.item_nm, '') AS parentCodeName, (i.use_at = 'Y') AS useAt, i.sort_order AS sortOrder, COALESCE(i.item_dc, '') AS codeDesc FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item p ON p.common_code_item_id = i.parent_item_id WHERE i.tenant_id = #{value} ORDER BY g.sort_order, g.group_code, i.sort_order, i.item_code

INSERT INTO tb_common_code_group ( tenant_id, group_code, group_nm, group_dc, sort_order, use_at, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{groupCode}, #{groupName}, #{groupDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 10 FROM tb_common_code_group WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}), 'Y', #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, group_code) DO UPDATE SET group_nm = EXCLUDED.group_nm, group_dc = EXCLUDED.group_dc, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by RETURNING common_code_group_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_common_code_item ( tenant_id, group_id, item_code, item_nm, item_dc, sort_order, use_at, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{groupId}, #{code}, #{codeName}, #{codeDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sortOrder}, #{useAt}, #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} ) ON CONFLICT (group_id, item_code) DO UPDATE SET item_nm = EXCLUDED.item_nm, item_dc = EXCLUDED.item_dc, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, use_at = EXCLUDED.use_at, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
